hero_subtitle: Yega, Kora, Okure kandi Okutunguuka — omuhanda gwawe gw'okutunga emigisha nigutandikira aha.
tip_save: Yebiikira hakiri ebicweka ikumi ahari igana by'entaasya yaawe buri sande — esente nkye nizikura juba!
tip_sacco: Yegaite aha guruupu y'okubiika sente ey'omwihanga (SACCO) okutunga za rooni n'okwombeka eibanja.
tip_photos: Kwata ebishushani by'ebintu byawe omu mushana gw'obuhangwa kugira ngu obone kuguza gye aha intaneeti.
tip_water: Nywa haakiri egiraasi 8 z'amaizi buri izooba kugira amagara marungi n'amaani.
tip_digital: Yegyezemu omuringo musya gwa digito buri sande — okuguma nookora nikukira okukora juba.
welcome_desc: Omuhwezi waawe ow'omutaano omu by'okwega, okutunga entaasya, okukura, n'okutunguuka. Naakora aha intaneeti hamwe n'ahansi yaayo — entunguuka yaawe neeba erinzirwe.
about_you_desc: Eki nikituhwera kumanya ebi orikukunda n'obuheereza oburikukuhwera.
your_health_matters_desc: Funa amakuru agarikwesigwa agarikukwata aha magara kandi okwatanise n'obuheereza omu kyanga kyawe.
maternal_health_desc: Okutwara enda, okureeberera omukazi aherize kuzaara, hamwe n'okuteekateekyera amaka
child_health_desc: Okugyema, endwara ezirikukira kureebeka, hamwe n'okureeberera abaana
mental_wellness_desc: Okurwanisa okwerarikirira, okweyendeza, hamwe n'obuhwezi bw'ebiteekateeko
nearby_services_sub: Ebyombeko by'eby'amagara hamwe n'obuheereza omu kyanga kyawe
ai_greeting: Halo! Ndi omuhwezi waawe kuruga omu Africa AI Connect. Nimbaasa kukuhwera n'obuhabuzi bwa bizinesi, obukoryo bw'obuhingi n'oburiisa, amakuru agarikukwata aha magara, obuhabuzi bw'eby'esente, hamwe n'ebindi bingi. Nooyenda kumanya ki?
chat_connection_error: Tukaba tutarikubaasa kuhikaana n'omuhwezi. Gyezaho ogarukye bwanyima.
cat_digital_desc: Kompyuta, intaneeti, hamwe n'ebintu by'okukoresa aha masimu
cat_finance_lit_desc: Okukora embaririra, okubiika, hamwe n'okukoresa gye esente
cat_agri_desc: Emiringo y'obuhingi n'oburiisa ey'omurembe hamwe n'eby'obushubuzi
cat_health_nut_desc: Eby'amagara g'eka, eby'endya, hamwe n'okugira amagara marungi
cat_leadership_desc: Obwebembezi bw'ekyanga hamwe n'emyoga y'okurwanirira abantu
sell_products_desc: Kwatanisa n'abaguzi omu kyanga kyawe n'okukiraho. Teeka ebintu byawe, teekaho emihendo, kandi oyongyere bizinesi yaawe.
popular_products_desc: Ebirikugambwaho munonga kuruga omu bakazi omu kyanga kyawe
no_listings_yet: Tihariho birikugambwaho — beera ow'okubanza kuta ekintu
grow_with_guidance_desc: Buri mukazi weena oine obusinguzi akaba aine omuntu owamwikiriize. Shanga omuhabuzi nainga obe omwe.
find_mentor_desc: Kwatanisa n'abakazi abaine obumanyi abarikubaasa kukuhwera
become_mentor_desc: Gabana obumanyi bwawe kandi oyimuse abandi
share_knowledge_desc: Hwera abakazi abandi kukura orikugabana emyoga yaawe n'obumanyi bwawe. Okuba omuhabuzi ni kimwe aha bintu ebirikukirayo kuhwera ebi orikubaasa kukora.
windows_recaptcha_note: Aha Windows, noobaasa kureeba omuringo gw'okuhamya obwire bukye batakwohereize koodi.

role_artisan_desc: Ninkora ebintu ebikozirwe n'emikono nari eby'emikono
